_notes: Achievements for the game prototype (game/sim/Core/Achievements.cs reads this; contract docs/achievements-contract.md; design doc claude.ai/artifact/PCswr9SQMHrgBsYsYUptAk; mockup docs/mockups/achievements/index.html). Every achievement earns one cosmetic (never gameplay); ids stay stable (a Steam build may map them later). rules.json: categories (id, name, order on the screen, icon), tiers (bronze 10 / silver 25 / gold 50 points and the medal colour), cosmetics (id, kind = rover_name | hull_number | paint | finish | dropship_name | beam_colour | dome_tint, name shown in the HANGAR tab, value = the text (names), the number as text (hull_number; the game pads it to the band width, 1 = 01), a #rrggbb colour (paint, beam_colour, dome_tint) or a finish id (brushed_gold, chrome, blue_white, gunmetal, pearl, rescue_white), colour2 = a paint's second colour or "", pattern = solid | band | chevrons | stripes for paint, "" otherwise). rover_name and hull_number are handed out by the sim (Simulation.SetCosmetics, before the game starts); the rest only change how the local player's things look. <category>.json: { "achievements": [ ... ] } with id (lower_snake, unique), name, description, category, tier, icon (a line icon of the mockup's set), hidden (shown as ??? until earned), progress (the screen shows a bar from Achievements.Progress), reward (a cosmetic id; each cosmetic belongs to one achievement at most), trigger and optional worlds { classes: [planet class ids], min_gravity_g, max_gravity_g, tier: open | masks | suits | domes | tech } (the surface must match for it to unlock). Trigger kinds: milestone { milestone, before_seconds (game time from tick 0), without (a building id never finished before it) } with milestones uplink (the landed outpost's uplink online), landed, first_metal (an Ore Refinery working), first_parasteel (parasteel in stock), second_base (two finished colony cores), research_all, built:<building id> (one finished), unit:<unit id> (one rolled out of a Vehicle Bay) - the balance runner's meanings; built { building, count } (finished buildings of that id at once); count { measure, at_least | all: true } with measures bodies_charted (all = every body of the star system; never without one), system_satellites, units (own vehicles on the surface), techs_known (all = every surface tech); share { measure: surveyed (share of the map's tiles), at_least 0..1 }; unit_counter { counter: tiles_driven (hex edges crossed by one vehicle), at_least, units: [unit ids] }; event { event + fields }: orbit_farthest (the flagship enters orbit of the body farthest from the colony's body), charted_class { class } (a body of that class becomes Charted), deposit_found { amount } (the player surveys a deposit of at least that many units), founded (a construction rover's outpost is finished), deposit_reopened (a Deep-Core Mine reopens a used-up deposit), tyre_changed_field (a tyre change finishes away from a repair pad), limped_home (a disabled rover parks on its own core's repair pad), crawler_explosion (a mining crawler's breakdown is an explosion), domed_crewed_working (a crewed building works inside a finished Pressure Dome's cover), life_support_saved (a base's life support was at 0 for at least a second and came back before the grace ran out), order_relayed { delay_seconds } (a colony order arrives after at least that much signal delay), sos_answered { within_seconds } (the flagship is back in orbit of the colony's body within that many seconds of a breakdown or a disabled vehicle while it was away); streak { condition, seconds (at most 14400), from_start (true: it must hold from the first check of the game) } with conditions no_power_short (the player has a finished base and none is short of power) and flagship_home (the flagship is in orbit of the colony's body); set { measure: weather_seen (weather kinds over the player's vehicles and cores), contains: [weather kind ids] }; view_count { measure: ships_inspected, at_least | all: true } (counted by the game's view, not the sim); all_of / any_of { rules: [ triggers ] } (one level). The tracker checks once a second of game time; nothing unlocks in test mode (after a test-panel edit), with draft data or in the balance runner. All thresholds are fixed here (owner 2026-11-08).
